_comment: Committed expected-GA capability-manifest snapshot for honua-release#61's live capability-manifest canonical check (e2e/canonical_checks.py:check_capability_manifest). Every `expectedGa` id (minus `excluded`) must be advertised supported=true; when the check runs authenticated (an admin X-API-Key) the same ids must also be available=true, except the `availabilityGated` ids, which the candidate supports but a bare deployment leaves off by configuration or dependency. REFRESH RULE (honua-release#183): refresh only from a deployment actually running the manifest-pinned candidate, and record its deploymentRevision; the check fails closed when that revision differs from components.honua-server.sha, and tools/validate_platform.py fails `validate` when it lags the manifest pin. This snapshot was taken on 2026-10-10 from a local-docker boot of the pinned image ghcr.io/honua-io/honua-server@sha256:62e312a8210ddf632ec5b903a2759327321966f72cbb9f75c0b2a3d2c1243458 (nightly-3ecd214; e2e/local-docker/docker-compose.yml's db + server, run with ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production, Licensing__Mode=Disabled and no Redis like the redis-off cells, with a unique database password and master key and HostValidation__AllowedHosts=localhost, which Production requires), unauthenticated and with the admin key; both reported the same ids, lifecycles and supported flags (the unauthenticated call reports available=false / insufficient-policy where the admin call reports available=true, which the check never asserts). The deployment advertised deploymentRevision 3ecd214c1ce20e96ad4911b6f8447055dee9089d (commit-sha). demo.honua.io was not used because it does not serve the pin. Selection rule: every id the previous snapshot asserted (all still supported=true) plus every newly advertised id with lifecycle=implemented and supported=true. Preview and experimental ids (EDR, Coverages, WMTS, ImageServer, SensorThings, 3D/scene, providers, versioning.branch, admin.multi-tenancy) are not GA in 2026.1 and are not added; planned ids report supported=false and are not added.

availabilityGated.reason: lifecycle=preview and opt-in on this candidate (available=false / experimental-disabled by default). Asserted supported=true because the previous snapshot asserted it; availability depends on opting in.

lifecycle=preview and opt-in on this candidate (available=false / experimental-disabled by default). Asserted supported=true because the previous snapshot asserted it; availability depends on opting in.
Implemented, but available=false / dependency-unavailable on a deployment with no job backend configured (the bare cloud cells and local-docker).
Implemented, but available=false / disabled-by-configuration until GitOps release publishing is configured.
Implemented, but available=false / disabled-by-configuration until feature locking is enabled.
Implemented, but available=false / disabled-by-configuration until a rollback target is configured.

New at this candidate: implemented and supported, but available=false / dependency-unavailable on a deployment without Redis (the durable proposal store; the redis-off cells and local-docker). Redis is required for the governed control plane, so the redis-on cells are where it is available.

excluded.reason: Advertised again at this candidate as an experimental, opt-in capability (supported=true, available=false / experimental-disabled); not a GA surface, so it is not asserted. It also survives as the `mtls` transport, reported available=false / disabled-by-configuration. honua-server#2958 tracks the reclassification.

Gated: disabled-by-configuration (geofence enter/exit alerting is not enabled on every deployment profile). Present in the manifest as supported=true but not asserted available on a bare/demo deployment.
